result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.is_semiconnected()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if a directed graph is semiconnected. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L56990-L57054){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.is_semiconnected() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Is semiconnected](/assets/graphs/is-semiconnected.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Left: a chain A to B to C; for every pair one node reaches the other, so is_semiconnected() returns True. Right: a fork, A to B and A to C; B and C (shown in the accent color) cannot reach each other in either direction, so is_semiconnected() returns False." width="100%"} A directed graph is semiconnected when, for every pair of nodes, at least one can reach the other. It sits between weak connectivity (connected ignoring direction) and strong connectivity (each reaches the other). Semiconnected graphs are exactly those whose strongly connected components can be lined up in a single chain, as in a pipeline where every stage feeds into the next. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if the graph is semiconnected. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is undirected or empty. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} The condensation (the DAG of strongly connected components) must have a Hamiltonian path, which for a DAG means a topological order whose consecutive components are all joined by an edge. $O(V + E)$. Matches NetworkX's `is_semiconnected`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} A chain is semiconnected; two branches out of a common source are not, since neither branch reaches the other: ::: {#921e299f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec chain = ec.Graph(directed=True).add_nodes(["A", "B", "C"]) chain.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("B", "C")]) fork = ec.Graph(directed=True).add_nodes(["A", "B", "C"]) fork.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("A", "C")]) chain.is_semiconnected(), fork.is_semiconnected() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (True, False) ``` ::: :::
